Setup value spreadsheetId: Spreadsheet id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Workflow secret PRINTIFY_TOKEN: Printify API token for api.printify.com (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "Google Sheets Trigger" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_SPREADSHEET_ROW_CHANGED_TRIGGER). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_SPREADSHEET_ROW_CHANGED_TRIGGER --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Printify - Get Shops" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Printify - Get Shops1" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Printify - Get Products" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Printify - Update Product" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Printify - Update Product": a request field used $('OtherNode'); on Yantra $() resolves via the named upstream map when that node ran earlier, else the immediate upstream - check that expression.
"Loop Over Items" uses NodeLoop: process each item/batch, return through NEXT, and continue only after all results are collected.

"Repeat: Calculate Options" uses NodeRepeatUntil: carry each retry's state, return readiness through NEXT, and resume the selected exit only after onDone. Original interval waits are preserved. The attempt limit defaults to 30; adjust maxAttempts for the service or retry budget. Exhaustion stops with an error.

"Generate Title and Desc" used agent tools in the original: Wikipedia (toolWikipedia), Calculator (toolCalculator). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
"Update Product Option" (sheet.appendOrUpdate): Sheets upsert without a match key → APPEND only (soft).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
